description: Golden evaluation set for the Helix quality gate. Doc Q&A cases are scored with real RAG metrics (faithfulness, answer relevance, context precision); the Code Review and Support Triage cases assert structured-output correctness.

corpus.title: Subscription and Refund Policy
corpus.text:
Helix Subscription and Refund Policy

Trial period. Every new Helix workspace begins with a free trial that lasts 14 days from the date of signup. No credit card is required to start the trial.

Refunds. Customers may request a full refund within 30 days of their first payment. Approved refunds are issued back to the original payment method within 5 to 10 business days.

Plan limits. The Free plan allows 20 agent requests per day per user. The Pro plan removes the daily request cap entirely and adds priority support. Enterprise customers receive a dedicated support engineer and a 99.9 percent uptime guarantee.

Data retention. Documents uploaded to Helix are retained for 90 days after deletion in cold storage before being permanently destroyed. Audit logs are retained for 12 months.

Security. Helix is SOC 2 Type II certified. All data is encrypted at rest with AES-256 and in transit with TLS 1.3.

corpus.title: Engineering Handbook
corpus.text:
Helix Engineering Handbook

Deployments. Production deploys run every weekday at 14:00 UTC and require two approving reviews on the pull request. Hotfixes may bypass the schedule with an incident commander's approval.

On-call. The on-call rotation is one week long and changes every Monday at 10:00 UTC. The primary on-call engineer must acknowledge a page within 5 minutes.

Incident severity. A Sev1 incident is a total outage or confirmed data loss and pages the on-call engineer immediately. A Sev2 is a major feature degraded for more than 15 minutes. A Sev3 is a minor defect with a workaround.

Code review. Every pull request requires at least one approving review, and any change touching authentication or billing requires a second reviewer from the security guild.

corpus.title: Support Knowledge Base
corpus.text:
Helix Support Knowledge Base

Password resets. If a customer cannot sign in, direct them to the Forgot Password link on the login page. Reset emails are delivered within 5 minutes.

Duplicate charges. When a customer reports being charged twice, verify the transaction in the billing portal. Confirmed duplicate charges are refunded in full within 5 to 10 business days.

Service outages. For a reported outage, confirm the status page first. Outages affecting more than one customer are escalated immediately to the on-call engineer.

Data export. Customers can export their data from Settings, then Export, in either JSON or CSV format.
